ashley (partnerships): Kicking off a separate thread for private-offer onboarding across AWS/GCP/Azure. Need owners for: private offer activation flow, entitlement mapping to our internal trials, reseller-priced SKUs, and legal checklist for private offers.
diego (cloud-engineering): For AWS private offers we need to confirm the fulfillment flow: do we handle purchase notifications via SNS->lambda or rely on marketplace-provided postback? I prefer SNS so we control retries.
sophia (product): Product asks that private offers trigger an entitlement code we can tie to a trial period + dedicated pool allocation. Proposal: entitlement_code format = redwood:po:{offer_id}:{tier}. Can we ensure uniqueness?
maria (legal): We'll need contract addenda templates for private offers and reseller margin clarity. Also verify whether Azure's private plans expose customer billing identifiers to us; that affects data access clauses.
grace (not-in-list): — omitted —
eli (solutions): From SI/reseller side: resellers sometimes need a co-managed onboarding token; can we support a provisioning token that expires and scopes to an org? That simplifies SAML + account linking for customers.
diego (cloud-engineering): GCP note: Private marketplace in GCP expects a partner to have a Cloud Marketplace SaaS listing and a connected billing plan. Need to validate our billing account association and test the Marketplace Procurement API webhooks.
marketplace-bot: MarketplaceBot: created staging-private-offers project in org-redwood-staging, pubsub topic redwood-marketplace-events created.
sophia (product): Packaging question: Offer bundle should include a "dedicated-reserved" SKU and a "hosted-trial" SKU. Private offers can map to either; product will emit the entitlement payload to /entitlements endpoint. Need contract on TTL for entitlement (e.g., 14-day trial).
maria (legal): Agree on 14-day default but need opt-in for extended trials. Also require explicit data processing addendum when private offers include customer PII or telemetry.
eli (solutions): Could we have a simple CLI for resellers to create a provisional token during setup? Then ops can convert to a long-lived integration after verification.
diego (cloud-engineering): I'll draft the SNS lambda flow and a Pub/Sub adapter for GCP. Also will prepare an Azure Event Grid subscription prototype.
nashley (partnerships): Owners: diego -> fulfillment adapters + runbook; sophia -> entitlement spec + SKU mapping doc; maria -> private-offer legal templates; eli -> reseller token UX + CLI spec. Can everyone ack? Sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to review the first runbook.
maria (legal): ack. I'll upload a redline by EOD.
sophia (product): ack. I'll add example payloads and TTL fields.
diego (cloud-engineering): ack, will push a draft PR with SNS lambda and tests.
eli (solutions): ack, will prototype a CLI mock and share with partners this week.
marketplace-bot: MarketplaceBot: private-offer staging test triggered (test_id=po-test-2026-03-23) — results posted to #ci-results.
